summary.text: Nathan Toman is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 34 (Mandan), serving since 2013. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Finance and Taxation and Political Subdivisions.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Toman works in information systems for Ducks Unlimited Inc. and holds an AA and a BSC.
He chairs the interim Legislative Task Force on Government Efficiency and serves on the interim Information Technology Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Jessica, with five children.
